reasons.correctness: updateTicketStatus publishes SupportTicketResolvedEvent only for RESOLVED, after save. The port, adapter subject and listener catch-and-log match the interface exactly. Hidden tests 5/5; build green.
reasons.convention_fit: Port and adapter sit in support/ticket/port and adapter. Listener uses @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT) and catches failures. Constructor injection throughout. New *UnitTest classes use MockitoExtension. The service's existing test was updated for the new constructor argument.
reasons.design_fit: Service depends only on ApplicationEventPublisher. Listener depends on TicketNotificationPort, not the adapter. EmailService is reused. Minimal footprint, no duplicated lookup or mapping.
reasons.test_quality: Covers the service publishing on RESOLVED with payload checks, and no publish on other transitions. Listener tests the port call and swallowing a port failure. Adapter test checks the reference in subject. Fast, no Spring context.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries located the support package and existing Port, Adapter and EventListener classes. The agent then read SubscriptionNotificationEventListener and InvoicingPort/FakturowniaAdapter before editing. Later navigation leaned on globs.
